title: Bird Opening: From's Gambit
line: Black gives a pawn to aim the queen and bishop at White's king.

steps.text: Push the pawn on f2 two squares. It takes hold of the center square e5.
steps.after: Black offers a pawn at once: From's Gambit. It gives up a little for a fast attack.

steps.text: Take the pawn. Now you are a pawn up.
steps.after: Black offers a second pawn to open lines.

steps.text: Take that pawn too. After Black takes back, you are still a pawn up.
steps.after: Black's bishop aims at g3, and the queen can check on h4.

steps.text: Here White brought out the other knight. The queen checked, then gave herself up on g3, and the bishop mated.
Back to the gambit. Bring out the knight that guards h4. If the queen checks there, the knight takes her.

wrong.b1c3: That is the trap: the queen checks on h4, and after the pawn blocks, queen and bishop mate.

steps.hint: Which knight can reach a square that watches h4?
steps.after: White is a pawn up, and the king is safe. Black will push its pawns to chase the knight.

summary: Black gives pawns to aim queen and bishop at the king. The knight that guards the queen check stops the attack.
